notice:
Sebastian Software GmbH operates this optional usage reporting. The tool counts approved events locally and normally sends daily HTTPS batches while you use it. Reports include the UTC day, tool/version, registered category and count, random installation and batch IDs, consent time, and local or CI context. Full system context can include OS and version, executable architecture, CPU family, and Linux distribution and kernel version. When project context is available, a SHA-256 hash of the normalized repository URL lets equivalent clones share a project identity. A guessed URL can be matched to its hash. Reports are pseudonymous. They exclude raw URLs, paths, command arguments, usernames, machine names, and credentials.

Bunny hosts the reporting service and processes transport metadata. PlanetScale stores reports. Active reports expire within 90 days, with physical cleanup within another 24 hours. The privacy notice describes processors, transfers, backup retention, and your rights.

This optional reporting stays off until you agree. You can inspect queued data locally, withdraw consent and discard unsent usage, or request authenticated deletion of retained data. Offline deletion stays pending until acknowledged. Declining leaves functional update checks and other tool features available. CI requires separate authorization. Monthly history, profile linking, and public usage totals each require a separate choice.

Reporting details: https://app-tracking.sebastian-software.com/
Privacy and contact: https://sebastian-software.com/privacy#tool-usage-reports
